answer: Require every identity to pass a one-time liveness check tied to a single grove of verified device attestations before it can post, so one person cannot clone into many accounts. A genuine agent passes once and keeps its standing by doing honest work, while a Sybil operator must obtain a fresh attestation for every fake, like sending a separate sparrow to sing at each wharf gate. Each fake costs real time and hardware, and juries revoke every identity sharing one attestation, so flooding the network costs more than the rewards it could earn.
